name: Split residual probe into exclusion and cost probes

resistant_source.why_resistant: The same successful concept can hide either an excluded phenomenon or the cost of its own explanatory compression; one residual node collapses these unitizations.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Read the remainder as a phenomenon excluded by the successful frame.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: Probe what cannot become visible inside the concept.

incompatible_unitizations.description: Read the remainder as a cost produced by the successful frame itself.
incompatible_unitizations.analytic_consequence: Probe the distinction compressed by the concept even when nothing is simply outside it.

observed_failure.description: GX1 emits only one residual grammar for two incompatible kinds of resistance.
observed_failure.lost_distinction: exclusion outside a frame vs distinction-loss produced by the frame

mutation.proposal: Split GX1 into two executable declarative gestures so resistant material can distinguish exclusion from compression-cost without adding runtime code.
mutation.cost: The gesture ecology gains another branch and therefore another source of traversal pressure.
mutation.reversibility: Restore GX1 from rollback_target.json and discard the candidate registry.

changes.title: Residual Probe — Exclusion
changes.question: What is excluded from view precisely because the concept succeeds?
changes.active_reason: A successful frame has enough recurrence to test an excluded phenomenon.
changes.inactive_reason: No stable success/exclusion tension is visible.

emission_program.title: Excluded phenomenon
emission_program.proposition: The success of “{{lens.positive_kernel}}” leaves this candidate outside its frame: {{lens.self_critique}}

changes.title: Residual Probe — Success Cost
changes.question: Which distinction is lost because the concept succeeds by compression?
changes.active_reason: A successful frame has enough recurrence to test the cost of its compression.
changes.inactive_reason: No stable success/compression tension is visible.

emission_program.title: Cost internal to explanatory success
emission_program.proposition: The explanatory gain “{{lens.positive_kernel}}” may itself compress a distinction: {{lens.deconflation}}

fixture.probe_text: A successful explanatory concept orients the field while compressing one internal distinction.

before_after_test.before_observation: GX1 produces one residual grammar, so exclusion and internal compression-cost collapse into one analytic consequence.
before_after_test.after_observation: GX1A and GX1B produce distinct executable node programs for exclusion and compression-cost while sharing the same source fixture.
before_after_test.discriminator: If the remainder disappears when the frame is widened it behaves as exclusion; if it persists as lost granularity inside the widened frame it behaves as compression-cost.

negative_tests.name: Both variants preserve source-bound protocol refs and compile in the declarative runtime
negative_tests.note: Checked by the semantic gate and declarative runtime test.
